rules.rule: an import in a Java or Kotlin file of a class, a package (.*) or a static member whose javax name moved to jakarta in Jakarta EE 9, by the longest prefix of the mapping
a fully qualified javax name in the code of a Java or Kotlin file, such as @javax.persistence.Entity, that moved to jakarta, outside the imports and the package declaration
an import of javax.annotation.* (every name of the package), of which only the seven classes of Jakarta Annotations, such as PostConstruct, PreDestroy and Resource, moved to jakarta.annotation
a dependency of a pom.xml, a Gradle build or a version catalog whose group and artifact id are an API artifact of Java EE that holds javax packages
an xmlns or xmlns:prefix attribute of a deployment descriptor (web.xml, persistence.xml, beans.xml, faces-config.xml and the others of docs/method.md) whose value is a namespace of Java EE or J2EE
a string literal of a Java or Kotlin file, or a text or an attribute value of a deployment descriptor, that holds a javax name that moved to jakarta
a file under META-INF/services whose name is a javax service that moved to jakarta, or a line of it that names a javax provider class that moved
